locateQuestion.prompt: Is there a defect in how this job sequences indexing work with saving its progress? If so, mark the line(s) where it is; otherwise answer that there is none.
locateQuestion.explanation: The defect is docs.forEach(async (doc) => ...) in indexPage. forEach ignores the promises the async callback returns, so indexPage resolves immediately, before any upsert finishes. runOnce then saves the cursor and calls refresh() while upserts are still running, and any upsert rejection becomes an unhandled rejection instead of failing the run. If the process dies or an upsert fails, the cursor has already moved past documents that were never indexed, so they are silently skipped. Use await Promise.all(docs.map(...)) or a for...of loop with await.

choiceQuestions.prompt: When is the cursor saved relative to listing the page it describes?
choices: Before listChangedSince is called for that page
Only once, at the end of runOnce
After indexPage returns for the page, and only when nextCursor is non-null
choiceQuestions.explanation: Inside the loop, cursors.save runs after await this.indexPage(...) and after the `if (!page.nextCursor) break` check, so it saves only when a next cursor exists. It is not saved before listing, not once at the end, and refresh() runs after the loop.

choiceQuestions.prompt: How are the title and description tokenized for one document in buildFields?
choices: Concurrently, and buildFields waits for both before returning
Concurrently, but buildFields returns before the description finishes
Only the title is tokenized; the description is copied
choiceQuestions.explanation: Both analyze calls are started inside Promise.all and the result is awaited, so they run concurrently and both finish before the fields object is built. They are not sequential, the await means nothing returns early, and description tokens are produced (then truncated to 512).

choiceQuestions.prompt: A run finds no changed documents on the first page. What does runOnce do?
choices: Saves the same cursor and refreshes the index
Refreshes the index but does not save a cursor
Returns 0 without saving a cursor or refreshing
Loops forever re-reading the empty page
choiceQuestions.explanation: An empty docs array hits `break` before indexing or saving, total stays 0, and refresh is guarded by `if (total > 0)`. So nothing is saved or refreshed, and the break prevents looping.
